key_facts: For the selected catalog, CASE 1840 is covered as 01/89–12/01, but machine discovery is a dated partial snapshot; serial/PIN-specific fitment is not confirmed.

No standalone engine drive/fan belt part number was identified in the inspected evidence. The relevant inspected engine assemblies explicitly exclude the fan belt: 02-24 Cylinder Block, 4-390 Engine (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski007uni-loader/case-uni-loader-skid-steer-loader/engine/cylinder-block-4-390-engine/cn/FBCDE746-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/C9CB6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6), and 02-26A Cylinder Block (Europe), 4-390 Emissions Certified Engine (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski007uni-loader/case-uni-loader-skid-steer-loader/engine/cylinder-block-europe-4-390-emissions-certified-engine/cn/997CB87C-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/C9CB6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6).

The relevant water-pump assembly is 02-06 - WATER PUMP SYSTEM, 4-390 ENGINE (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski007uni-loader/case-uni-loader-skid-steer-loader/engine/water-pump-system-4-390-engine/cn/3D628663-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/C9CB6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6). Its inspected rows identify belt-tensioner components, not the drive belt itself: J936203, quantity 1, and J918944, quantity 1, with J918944 marked no longer available and order J936203 (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski007uni-loader/case-uni-loader-skid-steer-loader/engine/water-pump-system-4-390-engine/cn/3D628663-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/C9CB6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6).

The same assembly lists regional belt-tensioner supports: J925194, quantity 1, for North American models/PIN JAF0118968; J925195, quantity 1, for European models/PIN JAF0098065 and also shown for North American models; and J925207, quantity 1, for European models/PIN JAF0098065 (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski007uni-loader/case-uni-loader-skid-steer-loader/engine/water-pump-system-4-390-engine/cn/3D628663-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/C9CB6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6).

A77817 is a belt-tensioner pulley kit, quantity 1, used to replace the pulley of J918944 and including callouts 23–25. Those included pulley, bolt and seal rows are NSS (not sold separately), each quantity 1 (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski007uni-loader/case-uni-loader-skid-steer-loader/engine/water-pump-system-4-390-engine/cn/3D628663-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/C9CB6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6).

The catalog evidence is insufficient to identify the requested engine drive belt itself. The inspected assembly source does not establish completeness, and the local engine-group route was missing; this is a bounded catalog miss, not proof that no belt exists.
